subject: Hospitality
title: The Rise of Micro-Weddings
description: One-minute skill: The Rise of Micro-Weddings.

hook.text: Micro-weddings—under 50 guests—surged post-pandemic. Couples found intimate celebrations more meaningful than big ones.

buildup.text: Smaller guest lists allow higher per-person spending: better food, premium venues.

discovery.text: Hotels and restaurants offer weekday micro-wedding packages at 40% lower venue costs.

twist.text: Micro-weddings generate less total revenue per event but are easier to coordinate, less staff-intensive.

climax.text: The micro-wedding trend reflects broader values: experiences over spectacle, authenticity over tradition.

punchline.text: Under 50 guests, over-the-top quality. Micro-weddings proved less means more.

quiz.question: What makes micro-weddings attractive to hotels despite less total revenue?
options: Easier to coordinate, less staff-intensive, and schedulable more frequently
